items.title: Virtualization security: attack layers and misconfiguration impact
items.summary: A detailed breakdown of misconfigurations in virtual environment cybersecurity as shown by examples of ransomware cases on ESXi and Proxmox environments.

items.title: The SOC Files 5: Ghost in the pipeline, or a fileless SharePoint breach by Storm-2603
items.summary: Kaspersky researchers analyze a complex fileless cyberattack by Storm-2603 involving ToolShell exploitation and subsequent runtime subversion, and discuss how to detect such intrusions.

items.title: MLEP in KICS for Networks 5.0: how machine learning helps track network behavior of OT devices
items.summary: We explain how Kaspersky Industrial CyberSecurity for Networks uses Machine Learning Event Processor (MLEP) technology to help take inventory of assets and detect anomalies in industrial networks.

items.title: CyberStrikeAI in the wild: the use of AI in real-world attacks on organizations
items.summary: We analyze a series of attacks on educational institutions that were fully automated during the post-exploitation phase using the CyberStrikeAI penetration testing framework.

items.title: Filter generation in practice: from algorithms to LLMs
items.summary: We automate filter generation for security alerts using an algorithm, a large language model, and a group of LLM agents.

items.title: Unknown APT uses NetamLoader to attack a Win10 OS customized for governments in Asia
items.summary: Kaspersky researchers analyze a complex targeted attack employing NetamLoader, a sophisticated malicious framework and targeting a customized government OS.

items.title: Millions of security cameras at risk: DoS vulnerability in Intelbras devices
items.summary: During our research, we discovered a denial-of-service vulnerability that could affect millions of Intelbras IP camera systems built on the platform platform of a popular Chinese manufacturer.

items.title: An insecure neighbor: how a vulnerability chain led to an isolation bypass in cloud infrastructure
items.summary: A Kaspersky expert presents a cloud isolation bypass case honored at Russian Pentest Award 2026. Learn how vulnerabilities in Kubernetes, Konnectivity, and the overlay network lead to RCE and compromise of other tenants' services.

items.title: Deploying AI agents securely: how Kaspersky products mitigate AI threats
items.summary: We look at best practices for deploying AI tools securely in corporate environments, with Kaspersky Security Center and Kaspersky Endpoint Security as examples. We also cover ways that EDR and TIP can detect AI agents.

items.title: How APT41 revived the BlackLotus bootkit to attack diplomatic organizations in Central Asia
items.summary: Kaspersky GReAT experts discovered a new UEFI bootkit, BlackX. It exploits the Baton Drop vulnerability (CVE-2022-21894) and is similar to the BlackLotus bootkit.
